findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "assess_community_launch_readiness" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, build_partnership_business_case · Public sink: get_more_tools, build_partnership_business_case.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, build_partnership_business_case · Public sink: get_more_tools, build_partnership_business_case

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
